verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a team chat product, so the story applies. The evidence only shows an interactive bot framework for writing and running custom bots, which is a developer building block rather than a built-in AI assistant users can delegate tasks to. Nothing in the pack documents a native AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
